[31m+ <script>[39m
[31m+ (function initParticles() {[39m
[31m+   const canvas = document.getElementById('bg-particles');[39m
[31m+   if (!canvas) return;[39m
[31m+   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');[39m
[31m+   let w = (canvas.width = window.innerWidth);[39m
[31m+   let h = (canvas.height = window.innerHeight);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   window.addEventListener('resize', () => {[39m
[31m+     w = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;[39m
[31m+     h = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const particles = [];[39m
[31m+   const count = 45;[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {[39m
[31m+     particles.push({[39m
[31m+       x: Math.random() * w,[39m
[31m+       y: Math.random() * h,[39m
[31m+       vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35,[39m
[31m+       vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35,[39m
[31m+       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function render() {[39m
[31m+     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);[39m
[31m+     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';[39m
[31m+     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {[39m
[31m+       const p = particles[i];[39m
[31m+       p.x += p.vx;[39m
[31m+       p.y += p.vy;[39m
[31m+       if (p.x < 0) p.x = w;[39m
[31m+       if (p.x > w) p.x = 0;[39m
[31m+       if (p.y < 0) p.y = h;[39m
[31m+       if (p.y > h) p.y = 0;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       ctx.beginPath();[39m
[31m+       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
[31m+       ctx.fill();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       for (let j = i + 1; j < count; j++) {[39m
[31m+         const p2 = particles[j];[39m
[31m+         const dist = Math.hypot(p.x - p2.x, p.y - p2.y);[39m
[31m+         if (dist < 110) {[39m
[31m+           ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, ' + (1 - dist / 110) * 0.08 + ')';[39m
[31m+           ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;[39m
[31m+           ctx.beginPath();[39m
[31m+           ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);[39m
[31m+           ctx.lineTo(p2.x, p2.y);[39m
[31m+           ctx.stroke();[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     requestAnimationFrame(render);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   render();[39m
[31m+ })();[39m

[31m+ async function refresh() {[39m
[31m+   try {[39m
[31m+     const [stateResponse, logsResponse, healthResponse] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+       fetch('/api/state'),[39m
[31m+       fetch('/api/logs'),[39m
[31m+       fetch('/api/health'),[39m
[31m+     ]);[39m
[31m+     if (!stateResponse.ok) throw new Error('State API returned HTTP ' + stateResponse.status);[39m
[31m+     if (!logsResponse.ok) throw new Error('Logs API returned HTTP ' + logsResponse.status);[39m
[31m+     const state = await stateResponse.json();[39m
[31m+     const logsResult = await logsResponse.json();[39m
[31m+     const logs = Array.isArray(logsResult) ? logsResult : [];[39m
[31m+     window._health = healthResponse.ok ? await healthResponse.json() : { agents: [] };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const setText = (id, value) => {[39m
[31m+       const el = document.getElementById(id);[39m
[31m+       if (el) el.textContent = String(value);[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+     setText('stat-pending', state.queue?.pending ?? 0);[39m
[31m+     setText('stat-active', state.queue?.active ?? 0);[39m
[31m+     setText('stat-done', state.queue?.done ?? 0);[39m
[31m+     setText('stat-runs', state.telemetry?.totalRuns ?? 0);[39m
[31m+     const recent = Array.isArray(state.telemetry?.recent) ? state.telemetry.recent : [];[39m
[31m+     const tokenTotal = recent.reduce((sum, run) => sum + Number(run.totalTokens || 0), 0);[39m
[31m+     setText('stat-tokens', 'recent tokens: ' + tokenTotal.toLocaleString());[39m
[31m+     setText('stat-cost', '$' + Number(state.telemetry?.totalCostUSD || 0).toFixed(4));[39m
[31m+     setText('stat-updated', 'updated ' + new Date(state.timestamp || Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString());[39m
[31m+     document.querySelectorAll('.live-stat').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('data-error'));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const stages = ['INGEST_AGENT', 'ANALYST_AGENT', 'AUDITOR_AGENT', 'SYNTHESIZER_AGENT'];[39m
[31m+       const activeAgent = state.workflow && state.workflow.activeAgent;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       for (const agentId of stages) {[39m
[31m+         const node = document.getElementById('node-' + agentId);[39m
[31m+         const badge = document.getElementById('badge-' + agentId);[39m
[31m+         if (!node || !badge) continue;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         const st = (state.agents && state.agents[agentId] && state.agents[agentId].status) ? state.agents[agentId].status : 'IDLE';[39m
[31m+         const isActive = activeAgent === agentId || st === 'BUSY';[39m
[31m+         const isDone = st === 'DONE';[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         node.classList.toggle('active', isActive);[39m
[31m+         node.classList.toggle('done', isDone);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (isActive) {[39m
[31m+           badge.className = 'node-badge badge-active';[39m
[31m+           badge.textContent = 'ACTIVE';[39m
[31m+         } else if (isDone) {[39m
[31m+           badge.className = 'node-badge badge-done';[39m
[31m+           badge.textContent = 'DONE';[39m
[31m+         } else {[39m
[31m+           badge.className = 'node-badge badge-idle';[39m
[31m+           badge.textContent = 'READY';[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       console.warn('DAG state update error:', e);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const healthEl = document.getElementById('health-panel');[39m
[31m+       if (healthEl && window._health && Array.isArray(window._health.agents) && window._health.agents.length > 0) {[39m
[31m+         let html = '<table class="health-tbl">';[39m
[31m+         html += '<tr class="health-hdr"><th>AGENT</th><th>STATE</th><th>RUNTIME</th><th>HEARTBEAT</th></tr>';[39m
[31m+         for (const h of window._health.agents) {[39m
[31m+           const hs = (h.state || 'idle').toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+           const silent = h.lastHeartbeatAt ? Math.round((Date.now() - h.lastHeartbeatAt) / 1000) + 's' : (h.lastEventAt ? Math.round((Date.now() - h.lastEventAt) / 1000) + 's' : 'active');[39m
[31m+           html += '<tr class="health-row">' +[39m
[31m+             '<td class="health-agent">' + escapeHtml(h.agentId) + '</td>' +[39m
[31m+             '<td style="color:' + (hs === 'healthy' ? '#ffffff' : 'var(--text-muted)') + '">&#9679; ' + escapeHtml(h.state || 'IDLE') + '</td>' +[39m
[31m+             '<td class="health-rt">' + escapeHtml(h.runtimeType || 'local') + '</td>' +[39m
[31m+             '<td class="health-hb">' + silent + '</td>' +[39m
[31m+             '</tr>';[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         html += '</table>';[39m
[31m+         healthEl.innerHTML = html;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       console.warn('Health matrix render error:', e);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const logHtml = logs.map(line => {[39m
[31m+         let cls = 'log-gray';[39m
[31m+         if (line.includes('[SUCCESS]') || line.includes('[ERROR]')) cls = 'log-white';[39m
[31m+         return '<div class="' + cls + '">' + escapeHtml(line) + '</div>';[39m
[31m+       }).join('');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const logEl = document.getElementById('event-stream');[39m
[31m+       const emptyLogs = '<div class="log-gray">No orchestrator log entries yet.</div>';[39m
[31m+       if (logEl) {[39m
[31m+         logEl.innerHTML = logHtml || emptyLogs;[39m
[31m+         logEl.scrollTop = logEl.scrollHeight;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const logFullEl = document.getElementById('event-stream-full');[39m
[31m+       if (logFullEl) {[39m
[31m+         logFullEl.innerHTML = logHtml || emptyLogs;[39m
[31m+         logFullEl.scrollTop = logFullEl.scrollHeight;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       console.warn('Log stream render error:', e);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   } catch (err) {[39m
[31m+     console.error('Refresh error:', err);[39m
[31m+     const message = 'Dashboard data unavailable: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : String(err));[39m
[31m+     const logEl = document.getElementById('event-stream');[39m
[31m+     const logFullEl = document.getElementById('event-stream-full');[39m
[31m+     if (logEl) logEl.innerHTML = '<div class="log-white">' + escapeHtml(message) + '</div>';[39m
[31m+     if (logFullEl) logFullEl.innerHTML = '<div class="log-white">' + escapeHtml(message) + '</div>';[39m
[31m+     document.querySelectorAll('.live-stat').forEach(el => el.classList.add('data-error'));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ async function runSovereignAudit() {[39m
[31m+   const btn = document.getElementById('btn-trigger-bw');[39m
[31m+   const toast = document.getElementById('audit-status-toast');[39m
[31m+   if (btn) {[39m
[31m+     btn.disabled = true;[39m
[31m+     btn.innerHTML = '<span>⏳</span> ANALYZING T-07...';[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (toast) {[39m
[31m+     toast.style.display = 'block';[39m
[31m+     toast.innerHTML = 'Preparing the T-07 analysis and approval record...';[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   try {[39m
[31m+     const res = await fetch('/api/industrial/trigger', { method: 'POST' });[39m
[31m+     const data = await res.json();[39m
[31m+     if (data.status === 'in_progress' || data.status === 'unavailable') {[39m
[31m+       const busy = data.status === 'in_progress';[39m
[31m+       if (toast) toast.innerHTML = (busy ? '⏳ T-07 analysis is already in progress: ' : '⚠️ T-07 analysis unavailable: ') + escapeHtml(data.message || data.error || data.status);[39m
[31m+       if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.innerHTML = '<span>▶</span> RUN T-07 SAFETY AUDIT'; }[39m
[31m+       if (busy) setTimeout(refresh, 1000);[39m
[31m+     } else if (data.success) {[39m
[31m+       if (btn) btn.innerHTML = '<span>⚡</span> WAITING FOR REVIEW...';[39m
[31m+       if (toast) {[39m
[31m+         const runId = data.runId || (data.task && data.task.id) || 'UNKNOWN';[39m
[31m+         const approvalId = data.details && data.details.approvalId ? data.details.approvalId : 'see approval queue';[39m
[31m+         toast.innerHTML = '● T-07 analysis is ready. Run: ' + escapeHtml(runId) + ' · Approval: ' + escapeHtml(approvalId) + ' · <a href="/#/approvals" style="color:var(--accent,#00d2ff);text-decoration:underline;">Review evidence</a>';[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       setTimeout(refresh, 400);[39m
[31m+       setTimeout(() => {[39m
[31m+         if (btn) {[39m
[31m+           btn.disabled = false;[39m
[31m+           btn.innerHTML = '<span>▶</span> RUN T-07 SAFETY AUDIT';[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }, 12000);[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       if (toast) toast.innerHTML = '❌ Error: ' + (data.error || 'Failed to dispatch');[39m
[31m+       if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.innerHTML = '<span>▶</span> RUN T-07 SAFETY AUDIT'; }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   } catch (err) {[39m
[31m+     if (toast) toast.innerHTML = '❌ Network Error: ' + err.message;[39m
[31m+     if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.innerHTML = '<span>▶</span> RUN T-07 SAFETY AUDIT'; }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ let chartDataCache = null;[39m
[31m+ let hoveredIndex = -1;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ async function initTelemetry() {[39m
[31m+   const canvas = document.getElementById('telemetryCanvas');[39m
[31m+   if (!canvas) return;[39m
[31m+   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');[39m
[31m+   if (!ctx) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   try {[39m
[31m+     const res = await fetch('/api/industrial/chart-data');[39m
[31m+     chartDataCache = await res.json();[39m
[31m+     drawBwChart(canvas, ctx, chartDataCache);[39m
[31m+     renderRawTable(chartDataCache);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {[39m
[31m+       const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();[39m
[31m+       const mouseX = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (canvas.width / rect.width);[39m
[31m+       const padL = 34, padR = 24;[39m
[31m+       const gW = canvas.width - padL - padR;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (mouseX >= padL && mouseX <= canvas.width - padR) {[39m
[31m+         const ratio = (mouseX - padL) / gW;[39m
[31m+         hoveredIndex = Math.round(ratio * (chartDataCache.points.length - 1));[39m
[31m+         drawBwChart(canvas, ctx, chartDataCache);[39m
[31m+         showTooltip(e, chartDataCache.points[hoveredIndex]);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     canvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {[39m
[31m+       hoveredIndex = -1;[39m
[31m+       drawBwChart(canvas, ctx, chartDataCache);[39m
[31m+       const tooltip = document.getElementById('chartTooltip');[39m
[31m+       if (tooltip) tooltip.style.display = 'none';[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   } catch (err) {[39m
[31m+     console.error('Chart load error:', err);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function showTooltip(e, p) {[39m

[31m+   if (!tooltip || !p) return;[39m
[31m+   const canvas = document.getElementById('telemetryCanvas');[39m
[31m+   const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   tooltip.innerHTML = [39m
[31m+     '<div style="font-weight:700;color:#ffffff;margin-bottom:3px">Row ' + p.row + ' · ' + p.time + '</div>' +[39m
[31m+     '<div>Vibration: <strong>' + p.vib.toFixed(2) + ' mm/s</strong> (Limit: 7.10)</div>' +[39m
[31m+     '<div>Bearing Temp: <strong>' + p.temp.toFixed(2) + ' °C</strong> (Limit: 95.0)</div>' +[39m
[31m+     '<div style="color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:2px">RPM: ' + p.rpm + ' · Load: ' + p.load + '%</div>' +[39m
[31m+     '<div style="margin-top:3px;font-weight:700">Verdict: ' + p.severity + '</div>';[39m
[31m+[39m

[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function highlightPoint(row) {[39m
[31m+   if (!chartDataCache) return;[39m
[31m+   const idx = chartDataCache.points.findIndex(p => p.row === row);[39m
[31m+   if (idx !== -1) {[39m
[31m+     hoveredIndex = idx;[39m
[31m+     const canvas = document.getElementById('telemetryCanvas');[39m
[31m+     const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');[39m
[31m+     drawBwChart(canvas, ctx, chartDataCache);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function drawBwChart(canvas, ctx, data) {[39m
[31m+   if (!data || !data.points || data.points.length === 0) return;[39m
[31m+   const pts = data.points;[39m
[31m+   const w = canvas.width;[39m
[31m+   const h = canvas.height;[39m
[31m+   const padL = 34, padR = 24, padT = 18, padB = 24;[39m
[31m+   const gW = w - padL - padR;[39m
[31m+   const gH = h - padT - padB;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   ctx.strokeStyle = '#181818';[39m
[31m+   ctx.lineWidth = 1;[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {[39m
[31m+     const y = padT + (gH / 4) * i;[39m
[31m+     ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(padL, y); ctx.lineTo(w - padR, y); ctx.stroke();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const vibMax = 10;[39m
[31m+   const tempMin = 50, tempMax = 110;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function xFor(i) { return padL + (i / (pts.length - 1)) * gW; }[39m
[31m+   function yVib(v) { return padT + gH - (Math.min(v, vibMax) / vibMax) * gH; }[39m
[31m+   function yTemp(t) { return padT + gH - ((Math.min(Math.max(t, tempMin), tempMax) - tempMin) / (tempMax - tempMin)) * gH; }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const vibWarnY = yVib(data.thresholds.vibration.warning);[39m
[31m+   const vibCritY = yVib(data.thresholds.vibration.critical);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   ctx.setLineDash([3, 3]);[39m
[31m+   ctx.strokeStyle = '#444444';[39m
[31m+   ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(padL, vibWarnY); ctx.lineTo(w - padR, vibWarnY); ctx.stroke();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   ctx.strokeStyle = '#666666';[39m
[31m+   ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(padL, vibCritY); ctx.lineTo(w - padR, vibCritY); ctx.stroke();[39m
[31m+   ctx.setLineDash([]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, padT, 0, padT + gH);[39m
[31m+   grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)');[39m
[31m+   grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.0)');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   ctx.beginPath();[39m
[31m+   ctx.moveTo(xFor(0), yVib(pts[0].vib));[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {[39m
[31m+     ctx.lineTo(xFor(i), yVib(pts[i].vib));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   ctx.lineTo(xFor(pts.length - 1), padT + gH);[39m
[31m+   ctx.lineTo(xFor(0), padT + gH);[39m
[31m+   ctx.closePath();[39m
[31m+   ctx.fillStyle = grad;[39m
[31m+   ctx.fill();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';[39m
[31m+   ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;[39m
[31m+   ctx.beginPath();[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {[39m
[31m+     const x = xFor(i);[39m
[31m+     const y = yVib(pts[i].vib);[39m
[31m+     if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);[39m
[31m+     else ctx.lineTo(x, y);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   ctx.stroke();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   ctx.strokeStyle = '#777777';[39m
[31m+   ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;[39m
[31m+   ctx.beginPath();[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {[39m
[31m+     const x = xFor(i);[39m
[31m+     const y = yTemp(pts[i].temp);[39m
[31m+     if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);[39m
[31m+     else ctx.lineTo(x, y);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   ctx.stroke();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (hoveredIndex >= 0 && hoveredIndex < pts.length) {[39m
[31m+     const hx = xFor(hoveredIndex);[39m
[31m+     ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';[39m
[31m+     ctx.lineWidth = 1;[39m
[31m+     ctx.setLineDash([2, 2]);[39m
[31m+     ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(hx, padT); ctx.lineTo(hx, padT + gH); ctx.stroke();[39m
[31m+     ctx.setLineDash([]);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {[39m
[31m+     const p = pts[i];[39m
[31m+     if (!p.anomaly) continue;[39m
[31m+     const x = xFor(i);[39m
[31m+     const y = p.vib >= data.thresholds.vibration.warning ? yVib(p.vib) : yTemp(p.temp);[39m
[31m+     const isFail = p.severity === 'FAIL';[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     ctx.beginPath();[39m
[31m+     ctx.arc(x, y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
[31m+     ctx.fillStyle = isFail ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)';[39m
[31m+     ctx.fill();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     ctx.beginPath();[39m
[31m+     ctx.arc(x, y, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
[31m+     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';[39m
[31m+     ctx.fill();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';[39m
[31m+     ctx.font = 'bold 9px monospace';[39m
[31m+     ctx.fillText('R' + p.row, x - 8, y - 10);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function renderRawTable(data) {[39m
[31m+   const container = document.getElementById('raw-table-container');[39m
[31m+   if (!container || !data || !data.rawRows) return;[39m
[31m+   const rows = data.rawRows;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   let html = '<table><thead><tr><th>ROW</th><th>TIMESTAMP</th><th>VIBRATION RMS</th><th>BEARING TEMP</th><th>RPM</th><th>LOAD %</th><th>STATUS</th></tr></thead><tbody>';[39m
[31m+   for (const r of rows) {[39m
[31m+     const isAnom = r.anomaly;[39m
[31m+     html += '<tr class="' + (isAnom ? 'anomaly-row' : '') + '">' +[39m
[31m+       '<td>' + r.row + '</td>' +[39m
[31m+       '<td>' + r.time + '</td>' +[39m
[31m+       '<td>' + r.vib.toFixed(2) + ' mm/s</td>' +[39m
[31m+       '<td>' + r.temp.toFixed(2) + ' °C</td>' +[39m
[31m+       '<td>' + r.rpm + '</td>' +[39m
[31m+       '<td>' + r.load + '%</td>' +[39m
[31m+       '<td>' + (isAnom ? '<strong>' + r.severity + '</strong>' : 'NORMAL') + '</td>' +[39m
[31m+       '</tr>';[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   html += '</tbody></table>';[39m
[31m+   container.innerHTML = html;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function parseMarkdown(md) {[39m
[31m+   if (!md) return '';[39m
[31m+   const lines = md.split('\n');[39m
[31m+   let html = '';[39m
[31m+   let inTable = false;[39m
[31m+   let inCode = false;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {[39m
[31m+     const line = lines[i].trim();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (line.startsWith('```')) {[39m
[31m+       inCode = !inCode;[39m
[31m+       html += inCode ? '<pre class="md-pre">' : '</pre>';[39m
[31m+       continue;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (inCode) {[39m
[31m+       html += escapeHtml(line) + '\n';[39m
[31m+       continue;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (line.startsWith('|') && line.endsWith('|')) {[39m
[31m+       if (!inTable) {[39m
[31m+         inTable = true;[39m
[31m+         html += '<table>';[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (line.includes('---')) continue;[39m
[31m+       const cells = line.split('|').map(c => c.trim()).filter((_, idx, arr) => idx > 0 && idx < arr.length - 1);[39m
[31m+       const isHeader = !html.includes('<tbody>');[39m
[31m+       if (isHeader && !html.includes('<thead>')) {[39m
[31m+         html += '<thead><tr>' + cells.map(c => '<th>' + formatInline(c) + '</th>').join('') + '</tr></thead><tbody>';[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         html += '<tr>' + cells.map(c => '<td>' + formatInline(c) + '</td>').join('') + '</tr>';[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       continue;[39m
[31m+     } else if (inTable) {[39m
[31m+       inTable = false;[39m
[31m+       html += '</tbody></table>';[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (line.startsWith('# ')) {[39m
[31m+       html += '<h2 class="md-h2">' + formatInline(line.slice(2)) + '</h2>';[39m
[31m+     } else if (line.startsWith('## ')) {[39m
[31m+       html += '<h3 class="md-h3">' + formatInline(line.slice(3)) + '</h3>';[39m
[31m+     } else if (line.startsWith('### ')) {[39m
[31m+       html += '<h4 class="md-h4">' + formatInline(line.slice(4)) + '</h4>';[39m
[31m+     } else if (line.startsWith('- ') || line.startsWith('* ')) {[39m
[31m+       html += '<div class="md-li">' + formatInline(line.slice(2)) + '</div>';[39m
[31m+     } else if (line.length > 0) {[39m
[31m+       html += '<p class="md-p">' + formatInline(line) + '</p>';[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (inTable) html += '</tbody></table>';[39m
[31m+   return html;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatInline(str) {[39m
[31m+   return escapeHtml(str)[39m
[31m+     .replace(/**(.*?)**/g, '<strong class="md-bold">$1</strong>')[39m
[31m+     .replace(/*(.*?)*/g, '<em>$1</em>')[39m
[31m+     .replace(new RegExp('`([^`]+)`', 'g'), '<code class="md-code">$1</code>')[39m
[31m+     .replace(/FAIL/g, '<span class="md-fail">FAIL</span>')[39m
[31m+     .replace(/WARNING/g, '<span class="md-warn">WARNING</span>')[39m
[31m+     .replace(/PASS/g, '<span class="md-pass">PASS</span>');[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ async function loadReport() {[39m
[31m+   const el = document.getElementById('dossier-report');[39m
[31m+   const fullEl = document.getElementById('dossier-report-full');[39m
[31m+   try {[39m
[31m+     const res = await fetch('/api/industrial/report');[39m
[31m+     const data = await res.json();[39m
[31m+     if (data.exists && data.content) {[39m
[31m+       const parsed = parseMarkdown(data.content);[39m
[31m+       if (el) el.innerHTML = parsed;[39m
[31m+       if (fullEl) fullEl.innerHTML = parsed;[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       if (el) el.textContent = 'Report not yet generated. Start the T-07 audit and review its approval first.';[39m
[31m+       if (fullEl) fullEl.textContent = 'Report not yet generated. Start the T-07 audit and review its approval first.';[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   } catch {[39m
[31m+     if (el) el.textContent = 'Unable to load report.';[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function escapeHtml(s) {[39m
[31m+   return String(s ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ <script>[39m
[31m+ (function initParticles() {[39m
[31m+   const canvas = document.getElementById('bg-particles');[39m
[31m+   if (!canvas) return;[39m
[31m+   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');[39m
[31m+   let w = (canvas.width = window.innerWidth);[39m
[31m+   let h = (canvas.height = window.innerHeight);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   window.addEventListener('resize', () => {[39m
[31m+     w = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;[39m
[31m+     h = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const particles = [];[39m
[31m+   const count = 45;[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {[39m
[31m+     particles.push({[39m
[31m+       x: Math.random() * w,[39m
[31m+       y: Math.random() * h,[39m
[31m+       vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35,[39m
[31m+       vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35,[39m
[31m+       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function render() {[39m
[31m+     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);[39m
[31m+     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';[39m
[31m+     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {[39m
[31m+       const p = particles[i];[39m
[31m+       p.x += p.vx;[39m
[31m+       p.y += p.vy;[39m
[31m+       if (p.x < 0) p.x = w;[39m
[31m+       if (p.x > w) p.x = 0;[39m
[31m+       if (p.y < 0) p.y = h;[39m
[31m+       if (p.y > h) p.y = 0;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       ctx.beginPath();[39m
[31m+       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
[31m+       ctx.fill();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       for (let j = i + 1; j < count; j++) {[39m
[31m+         const p2 = particles[j];[39m
[31m+         const dist = Math.hypot(p.x - p2.x, p.y - p2.y);[39m
[31m+         if (dist < 110) {[39m
[31m+           ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, ' + (1 - dist / 110) * 0.08 + ')';[39m
[31m+           ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;[39m
[31m+           ctx.beginPath();[39m
[31m+           ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);[39m
[31m+           ctx.lineTo(p2.x, p2.y);[39m
[31m+           ctx.stroke();[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     requestAnimationFrame(render);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   render();[39m
[31m+ })();[39m

[31m+ function switchTab(tab) {[39m
[31m+   document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));[39m
[31m+   const btn = document.getElementById('tab-' + tab);[39m
[31m+   if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const viewOverview = document.getElementById('view-overview');[39m
[31m+   const viewRaw = document.getElementById('view-raw');[39m
[31m+   const viewDossierFull = document.getElementById('view-dossier-full');[39m
[31m+   const viewStreamFull = document.getElementById('view-stream-full');[39m
[31m+   const viewBottom = document.getElementById('view-bottom');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (tab === 'overview') {[39m
[31m+     if (viewOverview) viewOverview.style.display = 'grid';[39m
[31m+     if (viewRaw) viewRaw.style.display = 'none';[39m
[31m+     if (viewDossierFull) viewDossierFull.style.display = 'none';[39m
[31m+     if (viewStreamFull) viewStreamFull.style.display = 'none';[39m
[31m+     if (viewBottom) viewBottom.style.display = 'grid';[39m
[31m+   } else if (tab === 'raw') {[39m
[31m+     if (viewOverview) viewOverview.style.display = 'none';[39m
[31m+     if (viewRaw) viewRaw.style.display = 'flex';[39m
[31m+     if (viewDossierFull) viewDossierFull.style.display = 'none';[39m
[31m+     if (viewStreamFull) viewStreamFull.style.display = 'none';[39m
[31m+     if (viewBottom) viewBottom.style.display = 'none';[39m
[31m+   } else if (tab === 'dossier') {[39m
[31m+     if (viewOverview) viewOverview.style.display = 'none';[39m
[31m+     if (viewRaw) viewRaw.style.display = 'none';[39m
[31m+     if (viewDossierFull) viewDossierFull.style.display = 'flex';[39m
[31m+     if (viewStreamFull) viewStreamFull.style.display = 'none';[39m
[31m+     if (viewBottom) viewBottom.style.display = 'none';[39m
[31m+     loadReport();[39m
[31m+   } else if (tab === 'stream') {[39m
[31m+     if (viewOverview) viewOverview.style.display = 'none';[39m
[31m+     if (viewRaw) viewRaw.style.display = 'none';[39m
[31m+     if (viewDossierFull) viewDossierFull.style.display = 'none';[39m
[31m+     if (viewStreamFull) viewStreamFull.style.display = 'flex';[39m
[31m+     if (viewBottom) viewBottom.style.display = 'none';[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ async function refresh() {[39m
[31m+   try {[39m
[31m+     const [stateResponse, logsResponse, healthResponse] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+       fetch('/api/state'),[39m
[31m+       fetch('/api/logs'),[39m
[31m+       fetch('/api/health'),[39m
[31m+     ]);[39m
[31m+     if (!stateResponse.ok) throw new Error('State API returned HTTP ' + stateResponse.status);[39m
[31m+     if (!logsResponse.ok) throw new Error('Logs API returned HTTP ' + logsResponse.status);[39m
[31m+     const state = await stateResponse.json();[39m
[31m+     const logsResult = await logsResponse.json();[39m
[31m+     const logs = Array.isArray(logsResult) ? logsResult : [];[39m
[31m+     window._health = healthResponse.ok ? await healthResponse.json() : { agents: [] };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const setText = (id, value) => {[39m
[31m+       const el = document.getElementById(id);[39m
[31m+       if (el) el.textContent = String(value);[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+     setText('stat-pending', state.queue?.pending ?? 0);[39m
[31m+     setText('stat-active', state.queue?.active ?? 0);[39m
[31m+     setText('stat-done', state.queue?.done ?? 0);[39m
[31m+     setText('stat-runs', state.telemetry?.totalRuns ?? 0);[39m
[31m+     const recent = Array.isArray(state.telemetry?.recent) ? state.telemetry.recent : [];[39m
[31m+     const tokenTotal = recent.reduce((sum, run) => sum + Number(run.totalTokens || 0), 0);[39m
[31m+     setText('stat-tokens', 'recent tokens: ' + tokenTotal.toLocaleString());[39m
[31m+     setText('stat-cost', '$' + Number(state.telemetry?.totalCostUSD || 0).toFixed(4));[39m
[31m+     setText('stat-updated', 'updated ' + new Date(state.timestamp || Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString());[39m
[31m+     document.querySelectorAll('.live-stat').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('data-error'));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const stages = ['INGEST_AGENT', 'ANALYST_AGENT', 'AUDITOR_AGENT', 'SYNTHESIZER_AGENT'];[39m
[31m+       const activeAgent = state.workflow && state.workflow.activeAgent;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       for (const agentId of stages) {[39m
[31m+         const node = document.getElementById('node-' + agentId);[39m
[31m+         const badge = document.getElementById('badge-' + agentId);[39m
[31m+         if (!node || !badge) continue;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         const st = (state.agents && state.agents[agentId] && state.agents[agentId].status) ? state.agents[agentId].status : 'IDLE';[39m
[31m+         const isActive = activeAgent === agentId || st === 'BUSY';[39m
[31m+         const isDone = st === 'DONE';[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         node.classList.toggle('active', isActive);[39m
[31m+         node.classList.toggle('done', isDone);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (isActive) {[39m
[31m+           badge.className = 'node-badge badge-active';[39m
[31m+           badge.textContent = 'ACTIVE';[39m
[31m+         } else if (isDone) {[39m
[31m+           badge.className = 'node-badge badge-done';[39m
[31m+           badge.textContent = 'DONE';[39m
[31m+         } else {[39m
[31m+           badge.className = 'node-badge badge-idle';[39m
[31m+           badge.textContent = 'READY';[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       console.warn('DAG state update error:', e);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const healthEl = document.getElementById('health-panel');[39m
[31m+       if (healthEl && window._health && Array.isArray(window._health.agents) && window._health.agents.length > 0) {[39m
[31m+         let html = '<table class="health-tbl">';[39m
[31m+         html += '<tr class="health-hdr"><th>AGENT</th><th>STATE</th><th>RUNTIME</th><th>HEARTBEAT</th></tr>';[39m
[31m+         for (const h of window._health.agents) {[39m
[31m+           const hs = (h.state || 'idle').toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+           const silent = h.lastHeartbeatAt ? Math.round((Date.now() - h.lastHeartbeatAt) / 1000) + 's' : (h.lastEventAt ? Math.round((Date.now() - h.lastEventAt) / 1000) + 's' : 'active');[39m
[31m+           html += '<tr class="health-row">' +[39m
[31m+             '<td class="health-agent">' + escapeHtml(h.agentId) + '</td>' +[39m

[31m+ async function initTelemetry() {[39m
[31m+   const canvas = document.getElementById('telemetryCanvas');[39m
[31m+   if (!canvas) return;[39m
[31m+   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');[39m
[31m+   if (!ctx) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   try {[39m
[31m+     const res = await fetch('/api/industrial/chart-data');[39m
[31m+     chartDataCache = await res.json();[39m
[31m+     drawBwChart(canvas, ctx, chartDataCache);[39m
[31m+     renderRawTable(chartDataCache);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {[39m
[31m+       const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();[39m
[31m+       const mouseX = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (canvas.width / rect.width);[39m
[31m+       const padL = 34, padR = 24;[39m
[31m+       const gW = canvas.width - padL - padR;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (mouseX >= padL && mouseX <= canvas.width - padR) {[39m
[31m+         const ratio = (mouseX - padL) / gW;[39m
[31m+         hoveredIndex = Math.round(ratio * (chartDataCache.points.length - 1));[39m
[31m+         drawBwChart(canvas, ctx, chartDataCache);[39m
[31m+         showTooltip(e, chartDataCache.points[hoveredIndex]);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     canvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {[39m
[31m+       hoveredIndex = -1;[39m
[31m+       drawBwChart(canvas, ctx, chartDataCache);[39m
[31m+       const tooltip = document.getElementById('chartTooltip');[39m
[31m+       if (tooltip) tooltip.style.display = 'none';[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   } catch (err) {[39m
[31m+     console.error('Chart load error:', err);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+     drawBwChart(canvas, ctx, chartDataCache);[39m

[31m+ function drawBwChart(canvas, ctx, data) {[39m
[31m+   if (!data || !data.points || data.points.length === 0) return;[39m
[31m+   const pts = data.points;[39m
[31m+   const w = canvas.width;[39m
[31m+   const h = canvas.height;[39m
[31m+   const padL = 34, padR = 24, padT = 18, padB = 24;[39m
[31m+   const gW = w - padL - padR;[39m
[31m+   const gH = h - padT - padB;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   ctx.strokeStyle = '#181818';[39m
[31m+   ctx.lineWidth = 1;[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {[39m
[31m+     const y = padT + (gH / 4) * i;[39m
[31m+     ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(padL, y); ctx.lineTo(w - padR, y); ctx.stroke();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const vibMax = 10;[39m
[31m+   const tempMin = 50, tempMax = 110;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function xFor(i) { return padL + (i / (pts.length - 1)) * gW; }[39m
[31m+   function yVib(v) { return padT + gH - (Math.min(v, vibMax) / vibMax) * gH; }[39m
[31m+   function yTemp(t) { return padT + gH - ((Math.min(Math.max(t, tempMin), tempMax) - tempMin) / (tempMax - tempMin)) * gH; }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const vibWarnY = yVib(data.thresholds.vibration.warning);[39m
[31m+   const vibCritY = yVib(data.thresholds.vibration.critical);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   ctx.setLineDash([3, 3]);[39m
[31m+   ctx.strokeStyle = '#444444';[39m
[31m+   ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(padL, vibWarnY); ctx.lineTo(w - padR, vibWarnY); ctx.stroke();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   ctx.strokeStyle = '#666666';[39m
[31m+   ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(padL, vibCritY); ctx.lineTo(w - padR, vibCritY); ctx.stroke();[39m
[31m+   ctx.setLineDash([]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, padT, 0, padT + gH);[39m
[31m+   grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)');[39m
[31m+   grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.0)');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   ctx.beginPath();[39m
[31m+   ctx.moveTo(xFor(0), yVib(pts[0].vib));[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {[39m
[31m+     ctx.lineTo(xFor(i), yVib(pts[i].vib));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   ctx.lineTo(xFor(pts.length - 1), padT + gH);[39m
[31m+   ctx.lineTo(xFor(0), padT + gH);[39m
[31m+   ctx.closePath();[39m
[31m+   ctx.fillStyle = grad;[39m
[31m+   ctx.fill();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';[39m
[31m+   ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;[39m
[31m+   ctx.beginPath();[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {[39m
[31m+     const x = xFor(i);[39m
[31m+     const y = yVib(pts[i].vib);[39m
[31m+     if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);[39m
[31m+     else ctx.lineTo(x, y);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   ctx.stroke();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   ctx.strokeStyle = '#777777';[39m
[31m+   ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;[39m
[31m+   ctx.beginPath();[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {[39m
[31m+     const x = xFor(i);[39m
[31m+     const y = yTemp(pts[i].temp);[39m
[31m+     if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);[39m
[31m+     else ctx.lineTo(x, y);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   ctx.stroke();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (hoveredIndex >= 0 && hoveredIndex < pts.length) {[39m
[31m+     const hx = xFor(hoveredIndex);[39m
[31m+     ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';[39m
[31m+     ctx.lineWidth = 1;[39m
[31m+     ctx.setLineDash([2, 2]);[39m
[31m+     ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(hx, padT); ctx.lineTo(hx, padT + gH); ctx.stroke();[39m
[31m+     ctx.setLineDash([]);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {[39m
[31m+     const p = pts[i];[39m
[31m+     if (!p.anomaly) continue;[39m
[31m+     const x = xFor(i);[39m
[31m+     const y = p.vib >= data.thresholds.vibration.warning ? yVib(p.vib) : yTemp(p.temp);[39m
[31m+     const isFail = p.severity === 'FAIL';[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     ctx.beginPath();[39m
[31m+     ctx.arc(x, y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
[31m+     ctx.fillStyle = isFail ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)';[39m
[31m+     ctx.fill();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     ctx.beginPath();[39m
[31m+     ctx.arc(x, y, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
[31m+     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';[39m
[31m+     ctx.fill();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';[39m
[31m+     ctx.font = 'bold 9px monospace';[39m
[31m+     ctx.fillText('R' + p.row, x - 8, y - 10);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function renderRawTable(data) {[39m

[31m+   for (const r of rows) {[39m

[31m+ function parseMarkdown(md) {[39m
[31m+   if (!md) return '';[39m
[31m+   const lines = md.split('\n');[39m
[31m+   let html = '';[39m
[31m+   let inTable = false;[39m
[31m+   let inCode = false;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {[39m
[31m+     const line = lines[i].trim();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (line.startsWith('```')) {[39m
[31m+       inCode = !inCode;[39m
[31m+       html += inCode ? '<pre class="md-pre">' : '</pre>';[39m
[31m+       continue;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (inCode) {[39m
[31m+       html += escapeHtml(line) + '\n';[39m
[31m+       continue;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (line.startsWith('|') && line.endsWith('|')) {[39m
[31m+       if (!inTable) {[39m
[31m+         inTable = true;[39m
[31m+         html += '<table>';[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (line.includes('---')) continue;[39m
[31m+       const cells = line.split('|').map(c => c.trim()).filter((_, idx, arr) => idx > 0 && idx < arr.length - 1);[39m
[31m+       const isHeader = !html.includes('<tbody>');[39m
[31m+       if (isHeader && !html.includes('<thead>')) {[39m
[31m+         html += '<thead><tr>' + cells.map(c => '<th>' + formatInline(c) + '</th>').join('') + '</tr></thead><tbody>';[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         html += '<tr>' + cells.map(c => '<td>' + formatInline(c) + '</td>').join('') + '</tr>';[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       continue;[39m
[31m+     } else if (inTable) {[39m
[31m+       inTable = false;[39m
[31m+       html += '</tbody></table>';[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (line.startsWith('# ')) {[39m
[31m+       html += '<h2 class="md-h2">' + formatInline(line.slice(2)) + '</h2>';[39m
[31m+     } else if (line.startsWith('## ')) {[39m
[31m+       html += '<h3 class="md-h3">' + formatInline(line.slice(3)) + '</h3>';[39m
[31m+     } else if (line.startsWith('### ')) {[39m
[31m+       html += '<h4 class="md-h4">' + formatInline(line.slice(4)) + '</h4>';[39m
[31m+     } else if (line.startsWith('- ') || line.startsWith('* ')) {[39m
[31m+       html += '<div class="md-li">' + formatInline(line.slice(2)) + '</div>';[39m
[31m+     } else if (line.length > 0) {[39m
[31m+       html += '<p class="md-p">' + formatInline(line) + '</p>';[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (inTable) html += '</tbody></table>';[39m
[31m+   return html;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatInline(str) {[39m
[31m+   return escapeHtml(str)[39m
[31m+     .replace(/**(.*?)**/g, '<strong class="md-bold">$1</strong>')[39m
[31m+     .replace(/*(.*?)*/g, '<em>$1</em>')[39m
[31m+     .replace(new RegExp('`([^`]+)`', 'g'), '<code class="md-code">$1</code>')[39m
[31m+     .replace(/FAIL/g, '<span class="md-fail">FAIL</span>')[39m
[31m+     .replace(/WARNING/g, '<span class="md-warn">WARNING</span>')[39m
[31m+     .replace(/PASS/g, '<span class="md-pass">PASS</span>');[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ async function loadReport() {[39m
[31m+   const el = document.getElementById('dossier-report');[39m
[31m+   const fullEl = document.getElementById('dossier-report-full');[39m
[31m+   try {[39m
[31m+     const res = await fetch('/api/industrial/report');[39m
[31m+     const data = await res.json();[39m
[31m+     if (data.exists && data.content) {[39m
[31m+       const parsed = parseMarkdown(data.content);[39m
[31m+       if (el) el.innerHTML = parsed;[39m
[31m+       if (fullEl) fullEl.innerHTML = parsed;[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       if (el) el.textContent = 'Report not yet generated. Start the T-07 audit and review its approval first.';[39m
[31m+       if (fullEl) fullEl.textContent = 'Report not yet generated. Start the T-07 audit and review its approval first.';[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   } catch {[39m
[31m+     if (el) el.textContent = 'Unable to load report.';[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function escapeHtml(s) {[39m
[31m+   return String(s ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ </script>[39m

[31m+ <script>[39m
[31m+ (function initParticles() {[39m
[31m+   const canvas = document.getElementById('bg-particles');[39m
[31m+   if (!canvas) return;[39m
[31m+   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');[39m
[31m+   let w = (canvas.width = window.innerWidth);[39m
[31m+   let h = (canvas.height = window.innerHeight);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   window.addEventListener('resize', () => {[39m
[31m+     w = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;[39m
[31m+     h = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const particles = [];[39m
[31m+   const count = 45;[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {[39m
[31m+     particles.push({[39m
[31m+       x: Math.random() * w,[39m
[31m+       y: Math.random() * h,[39m
[31m+       vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35,[39m
[31m+       vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35,[39m
[31m+       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function render() {[39m
[31m+     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);[39m
[31m+     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';[39m
[31m+     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {[39m
[31m+       const p = particles[i];[39m
[31m+       p.x += p.vx;[39m
[31m+       p.y += p.vy;[39m
[31m+       if (p.x < 0) p.x = w;[39m
[31m+       if (p.x > w) p.x = 0;[39m
[31m+       if (p.y < 0) p.y = h;[39m
[31m+       if (p.y > h) p.y = 0;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       ctx.beginPath();[39m
[31m+       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
[31m+       ctx.fill();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       for (let j = i + 1; j < count; j++) {[39m
[31m+         const p2 = particles[j];[39m
[31m+         const dist = Math.hypot(p.x - p2.x, p.y - p2.y);[39m
[31m+         if (dist < 110) {[39m
[31m+           ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, ' + (1 - dist / 110) * 0.08 + ')';[39m
[31m+           ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;[39m
[31m+           ctx.beginPath();[39m
[31m+           ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);[39m
[31m+           ctx.lineTo(p2.x, p2.y);[39m
[31m+           ctx.stroke();[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     requestAnimationFrame(render);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   render();[39m
[31m+ })();[39m

[31m+ async function refresh() {[39m
[31m+   try {[39m
[31m+     const [stateResponse, logsResponse, healthResponse] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+       fetch('/api/state'),[39m
[31m+       fetch('/api/logs'),[39m
[31m+       fetch('/api/health'),[39m
[31m+     ]);[39m
[31m+     if (!stateResponse.ok) throw new Error('State API returned HTTP ' + stateResponse.status);[39m
[31m+     if (!logsResponse.ok) throw new Error('Logs API returned HTTP ' + logsResponse.status);[39m
[31m+     const state = await stateResponse.json();[39m
[31m+     const logsResult = await logsResponse.json();[39m
[31m+     const logs = Array.isArray(logsResult) ? logsResult : [];[39m
[31m+     window._health = healthResponse.ok ? await healthResponse.json() : { agents: [] };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const setText = (id, value) => {[39m
[31m+       const el = document.getElementById(id);[39m
[31m+       if (el) el.textContent = String(value);[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+     setText('stat-pending', state.queue?.pending ?? 0);[39m
[31m+     setText('stat-active', state.queue?.active ?? 0);[39m
[31m+     setText('stat-done', state.queue?.done ?? 0);[39m
[31m+     setText('stat-runs', state.telemetry?.totalRuns ?? 0);[39m
[31m+     const recent = Array.isArray(state.telemetry?.recent) ? state.telemetry.recent : [];[39m
[31m+     const tokenTotal = recent.reduce((sum, run) => sum + Number(run.totalTokens || 0), 0);[39m
[31m+     setText('stat-tokens', 'recent tokens: ' + tokenTotal.toLocaleString());[39m
[31m+     setText('stat-cost', '$' + Number(state.telemetry?.totalCostUSD || 0).toFixed(4));[39m
[31m+     setText('stat-updated', 'updated ' + new Date(state.timestamp || Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString());[39m
[31m+     document.querySelectorAll('.live-stat').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('data-error'));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const stages = ['INGEST_AGENT', 'ANALYST_AGENT', 'AUDITOR_AGENT', 'SYNTHESIZER_AGENT'];[39m
[31m+       const activeAgent = state.workflow && state.workflow.activeAgent;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       for (const agentId of stages) {[39m
[31m+         const node = document.getElementById('node-' + agentId);[39m
[31m+         const badge = document.getElementById('badge-' + agentId);[39m
[31m+         if (!node || !badge) continue;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         const st = (state.agents && state.agents[agentId] && state.agents[agentId].status) ? state.agents[agentId].status : 'IDLE';[39m
[31m+         const isActive = activeAgent === agentId || st === 'BUSY';[39m
[31m+         const isDone = st === 'DONE';[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         node.classList.toggle('active', isActive);[39m
[31m+         node.classList.toggle('done', isDone);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (isActive) {[39m
[31m+           badge.className = 'node-badge badge-active';[39m
[31m+           badge.textContent = 'ACTIVE';[39m
[31m+         } else if (isDone) {[39m
[31m+           badge.className = 'node-badge badge-done';[39m
[31m+           badge.textContent = 'DONE';[39m
[31m+         } else {[39m
[31m+           badge.className = 'node-badge badge-idle';[39m
[31m+           badge.textContent = 'READY';[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       console.warn('DAG state update error:', e);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const healthEl = document.getElementById('health-panel');[39m
[31m+       if (healthEl && window._health && Array.isArray(window._health.agents) && window._health.agents.length > 0) {[39m
[31m+         let html = '<table class="health-tbl">';[39m
[31m+         html += '<tr class="health-hdr"><th>AGENT</th><th>STATE</th><th>RUNTIME</th><th>HEARTBEAT</th></tr>';[39m
[31m+         for (const h of window._health.agents) {[39m
[31m+           const hs = (h.state || 'idle').toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+           const silent = h.lastHeartbeatAt ? Math.round((Date.now() - h.lastHeartbeatAt) / 1000) + 's' : (h.lastEventAt ? Math.round((Date.now() - h.lastEventAt) / 1000) + 's' : 'active');[39m
[31m+           html += '<tr class="health-row">' +[39m
[31m+             '<td class="health-agent">' + escapeHtml(h.agentId) + '</td>' +[39m
[31m+             '<td style="color:' + (hs === 'healthy' ? '#ffffff' : 'var(--text-muted)') + '">&#9679; ' + escapeHtml(h.state || 'IDLE') + '</td>' +[39m
[31m+             '<td class="health-rt">' + escapeHtml(h.runtimeType || 'local') + '</td>' +[39m
[31m+             '<td class="health-hb">' + silent + '</td>' +[39m
[31m+             '</tr>';[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         html += '</table>';[39m
[31m+         healthEl.innerHTML = html;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       console.warn('Health matrix render error:', e);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const logHtml = logs.map(line => {[39m
[31m+         let cls = 'log-gray';[39m
[31m+         if (line.includes('[SUCCESS]') || line.includes('[ERROR]')) cls = 'log-white';[39m
[31m+         return '<div class="' + cls + '">' + escapeHtml(line) + '</div>';[39m
[31m+       }).join('');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const logEl = document.getElementById('event-stream');[39m
[31m+       const emptyLogs = '<div class="log-gray">No orchestrator log entries yet.</div>';[39m
[31m+       if (logEl) {[39m
[31m+         logEl.innerHTML = logHtml || emptyLogs;[39m
[31m+         logEl.scrollTop = logEl.scrollHeight;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const logFullEl = document.getElementById('event-stream-full');[39m
[31m+       if (logFullEl) {[39m
[31m+         logFullEl.innerHTML = logHtml || emptyLogs;[39m
[31m+         logFullEl.scrollTop = logFullEl.scrollHeight;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       console.warn('Log stream render error:', e);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   } catch (err) {[39m
[31m+     console.error('Refresh error:', err);[39m
[31m+     const message = 'Dashboard data unavailable: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : String(err));[39m
[31m+     const logEl = document.getElementById('event-stream');[39m
[31m+     const logFullEl = document.getElementById('event-stream-full');[39m
[31m+     if (logEl) logEl.innerHTML = '<div class="log-white">' + escapeHtml(message) + '</div>';[39m
[31m+     if (logFullEl) logFullEl.innerHTML = '<div class="log-white">' + escapeHtml(message) + '</div>';[39m
[31m+     document.querySelectorAll('.live-stat').forEach(el => el.classList.add('data-error'));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ async function runSovereignAudit() {[39m
[31m+   const btn = document.getElementById('btn-trigger-bw');[39m
[31m+   const toast = document.getElementById('audit-status-toast');[39m
[31m+   if (btn) {[39m
[31m+     btn.disabled = true;[39m
[31m+     btn.innerHTML = '<span>⏳</span> ANALYZING T-07...';[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (toast) {[39m
[31m+     toast.style.display = 'block';[39m
[31m+     toast.innerHTML = 'Preparing the T-07 analysis and approval record...';[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   try {[39m
[31m+     const res = await fetch('/api/industrial/trigger', { method: 'POST' });[39m
[31m+     const data = await res.json();[39m
[31m+     if (data.status === 'in_progress' || data.status === 'unavailable') {[39m
[31m+       const busy = data.status === 'in_progress';[39m
[31m+       if (toast) toast.innerHTML = (busy ? '⏳ T-07 analysis is already in progress: ' : '⚠️ T-07 analysis unavailable: ') + escapeHtml(data.message || data.error || data.status);[39m
[31m+       if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.innerHTML = '<span>▶</span> RUN T-07 SAFETY AUDIT'; }[39m
[31m+       if (busy) setTimeout(refresh, 1000);[39m
[31m+     } else if (data.success) {[39m
[31m+       if (btn) btn.innerHTML = '<span>⚡</span> WAITING FOR REVIEW...';[39m
[31m+       if (toast) {[39m
[31m+         const runId = data.runId || (data.task && data.task.id) || 'UNKNOWN';[39m
[31m+         const approvalId = data.details && data.details.approvalId ? data.details.approvalId : 'see approval queue';[39m
[31m+         toast.innerHTML = '● T-07 analysis is ready. Run: ' + escapeHtml(runId) + ' · Approval: ' + escapeHtml(approvalId) + ' · <a href="/#/approvals" style="color:var(--accent,#00d2ff);text-decoration:underline;">Review evidence</a>';[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       setTimeout(refresh, 400);[39m
[31m+       setTimeout(() => {[39m
[31m+         if (btn) {[39m
[31m+           btn.disabled = false;[39m
[31m+           btn.innerHTML = '<span>▶</span> RUN T-07 SAFETY AUDIT';[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }, 12000);[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       if (toast) toast.innerHTML = '❌ Error: ' + (data.error || 'Failed to dispatch');[39m
[31m+       if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.innerHTML = '<span>▶</span> RUN T-07 SAFETY AUDIT'; }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   } catch (err) {[39m
[31m+     if (toast) toast.innerHTML = '❌ Network Error: ' + err.message;[39m
[31m+     if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.innerHTML = '<span>▶</span> RUN T-07 SAFETY AUDIT'; }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ let chartDataCache = null;[39m
[31m+ let hoveredIndex = -1;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ async function initTelemetry() {[39m
[31m+   const canvas = document.getElementById('telemetryCanvas');[39m
[31m+   if (!canvas) return;[39m
[31m+   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');[39m
[31m+   if (!ctx) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   try {[39m
[31m+     const res = await fetch('/api/industrial/chart-data');[39m
[31m+     chartDataCache = await res.json();[39m
[31m+     drawBwChart(canvas, ctx, chartDataCache);[39m
[31m+     renderRawTable(chartDataCache);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {[39m
[31m+       const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();[39m
[31m+       const mouseX = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (canvas.width / rect.width);[39m
[31m+       const padL = 34, padR = 24;[39m
[31m+       const gW = canvas.width - padL - padR;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (mouseX >= padL && mouseX <= canvas.width - padR) {[39m
[31m+         const ratio = (mouseX - padL) / gW;[39m
[31m+         hoveredIndex = Math.round(ratio * (chartDataCache.points.length - 1));[39m
[31m+         drawBwChart(canvas, ctx, chartDataCache);[39m
[31m+         showTooltip(e, chartDataCache.points[hoveredIndex]);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     canvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {[39m
[31m+       hoveredIndex = -1;[39m
[31m+       drawBwChart(canvas, ctx, chartDataCache);[39m
[31m+       const tooltip = document.getElementById('chartTooltip');[39m
[31m+       if (tooltip) tooltip.style.display = 'none';[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   } catch (err) {[39m
[31m+     console.error('Chart load error:', err);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function showTooltip(e, p) {[39m
[31m+   const tooltip = document.getElementById('chartTooltip');[39m
[31m+   if (!tooltip || !p) return;[39m
[31m+   const canvas = document.getElementById('telemetryCanvas');[39m
[31m+   const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   tooltip.innerHTML = [39m
[31m+     '<div style="font-weight:700;color:#ffffff;margin-bottom:3px">Row ' + p.row + ' · ' + p.time + '</div>' +[39m
[31m+     '<div>Vibration: <strong>' + p.vib.toFixed(2) + ' mm/s</strong> (Limit: 7.10)</div>' +[39m
[31m+     '<div>Bearing Temp: <strong>' + p.temp.toFixed(2) + ' °C</strong> (Limit: 95.0)</div>' +[39m
[31m+     '<div style="color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:2px">RPM: ' + p.rpm + ' · Load: ' + p.load + '%</div>' +[39m
[31m+     '<div style="margin-top:3px;font-weight:700">Verdict: ' + p.severity + '</div>';[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   tooltip.style.display = 'block';[39m
[31m+   tooltip.style.left = Math.min(e.clientX - rect.left + 15, rect.width - 200) + 'px';[39m
[31m+   tooltip.style.top = Math.max(e.clientY - rect.top - 70, 10) + 'px';[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function highlightPoint(row) {[39m
[31m+   if (!chartDataCache) return;[39m
[31m+   const idx = chartDataCache.points.findIndex(p => p.row === row);[39m
[31m+   if (idx !== -1) {[39m
[31m+     hoveredIndex = idx;[39m
[31m+     const canvas = document.getElementById('telemetryCanvas');[39m
[31m+     const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');[39m
[31m+     drawBwChart(canvas, ctx, chartDataCache);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function drawBwChart(canvas, ctx, data) {[39m
[31m+   if (!data || !data.points || data.points.length === 0) return;[39m
[31m+   const pts = data.points;[39m
[31m+   const w = canvas.width;[39m
[31m+   const h = canvas.height;[39m
[31m+   const padL = 34, padR = 24, padT = 18, padB = 24;[39m
[31m+   const gW = w - padL - padR;[39m
[31m+   const gH = h - padT - padB;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   ctx.strokeStyle = '#181818';[39m
[31m+   ctx.lineWidth = 1;[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {[39m
[31m+     const y = padT + (gH / 4) * i;[39m
[31m+     ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(padL, y); ctx.lineTo(w - padR, y); ctx.stroke();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const vibMax = 10;[39m
[31m+   const tempMin = 50, tempMax = 110;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function xFor(i) { return padL + (i / (pts.length - 1)) * gW; }[39m
[31m+   function yVib(v) { return padT + gH - (Math.min(v, vibMax) / vibMax) * gH; }[39m
[31m+   function yTemp(t) { return padT + gH - ((Math.min(Math.max(t, tempMin), tempMax) - tempMin) / (tempMax - tempMin)) * gH; }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const vibWarnY = yVib(data.thresholds.vibration.warning);[39m
[31m+   const vibCritY = yVib(data.thresholds.vibration.critical);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   ctx.setLineDash([3, 3]);[39m
[31m+   ctx.strokeStyle = '#444444';[39m
[31m+   ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(padL, vibWarnY); ctx.lineTo(w - padR, vibWarnY); ctx.stroke();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   ctx.strokeStyle = '#666666';[39m
[31m+   ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(padL, vibCritY); ctx.lineTo(w - padR, vibCritY); ctx.stroke();[39m
[31m+   ctx.setLineDash([]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, padT, 0, padT + gH);[39m
[31m+   grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)');[39m
[31m+   grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.0)');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   ctx.beginPath();[39m
[31m+   ctx.moveTo(xFor(0), yVib(pts[0].vib));[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {[39m
[31m+     ctx.lineTo(xFor(i), yVib(pts[i].vib));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   ctx.lineTo(xFor(pts.length - 1), padT + gH);[39m
[31m+   ctx.lineTo(xFor(0), padT + gH);[39m
[31m+   ctx.closePath();[39m
[31m+   ctx.fillStyle = grad;[39m
[31m+   ctx.fill();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';[39m
[31m+   ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;[39m
[31m+   ctx.beginPath();[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {[39m
[31m+     const x = xFor(i);[39m
[31m+     const y = yVib(pts[i].vib);[39m
[31m+     if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);[39m
[31m+     else ctx.lineTo(x, y);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   ctx.stroke();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   ctx.strokeStyle = '#777777';[39m
[31m+   ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;[39m
[31m+   ctx.beginPath();[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {[39m
[31m+     const x = xFor(i);[39m
[31m+     const y = yTemp(pts[i].temp);[39m
[31m+     if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);[39m
[31m+     else ctx.lineTo(x, y);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   ctx.stroke();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (hoveredIndex >= 0 && hoveredIndex < pts.length) {[39m
[31m+     const hx = xFor(hoveredIndex);[39m
[31m+     ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';[39m
[31m+     ctx.lineWidth = 1;[39m
[31m+     ctx.setLineDash([2, 2]);[39m
[31m+     ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(hx, padT); ctx.lineTo(hx, padT + gH); ctx.stroke();[39m
[31m+     ctx.setLineDash([]);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {[39m
[31m+     const p = pts[i];[39m
[31m+     if (!p.anomaly) continue;[39m
[31m+     const x = xFor(i);[39m
[31m+     const y = p.vib >= data.thresholds.vibration.warning ? yVib(p.vib) : yTemp(p.temp);[39m
[31m+     const isFail = p.severity === 'FAIL';[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     ctx.beginPath();[39m
[31m+     ctx.arc(x, y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
[31m+     ctx.fillStyle = isFail ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)';[39m
[31m+     ctx.fill();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     ctx.beginPath();[39m
[31m+     ctx.arc(x, y, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
[31m+     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';[39m
[31m+     ctx.fill();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';[39m
[31m+     ctx.font = 'bold 9px monospace';[39m
[31m+     ctx.fillText('R' + p.row, x - 8, y - 10);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function renderRawTable(data) {[39m
[31m+   const container = document.getElementById('raw-table-container');[39m
[31m+   if (!container || !data || !data.rawRows) return;[39m
[31m+   const rows = data.rawRows;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   let html = '<table><thead><tr><th>ROW</th><th>TIMESTAMP</th><th>VIBRATION RMS</th><th>BEARING TEMP</th><th>RPM</th><th>LOAD %</th><th>STATUS</th></tr></thead><tbody>';[39m
[31m+   for (const r of rows) {[39m
[31m+     const isAnom = r.anomaly;[39m
[31m+     html += '<tr class="' + (isAnom ? 'anomaly-row' : '') + '">' +[39m
[31m+       '<td>' + r.row + '</td>' +[39m
[31m+       '<td>' + r.time + '</td>' +[39m
[31m+       '<td>' + r.vib.toFixed(2) + ' mm/s</td>' +[39m
[31m+       '<td>' + r.temp.toFixed(2) + ' °C</td>' +[39m
[31m+       '<td>' + r.rpm + '</td>' +[39m
[31m+       '<td>' + r.load + '%</td>' +[39m
[31m+       '<td>' + (isAnom ? '<strong>' + r.severity + '</strong>' : 'NORMAL') + '</td>' +[39m
[31m+       '</tr>';[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   html += '</tbody></table>';[39m
[31m+   container.innerHTML = html;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function parseMarkdown(md) {[39m
[31m+   if (!md) return '';[39m
[31m+   const lines = md.split('\n');[39m
[31m+   let html = '';[39m
[31m+   let inTable = false;[39m
[31m+   let inCode = false;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {[39m
[31m+     const line = lines[i].trim();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (line.startsWith('```')) {[39m
[31m+       inCode = !inCode;[39m
[31m+       html += inCode ? '<pre class="md-pre">' : '</pre>';[39m
[31m+       continue;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (inCode) {[39m
[31m+       html += escapeHtml(line) + '\n';[39m
[31m+       continue;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (line.startsWith('|') && line.endsWith('|')) {[39m
[31m+       if (!inTable) {[39m
[31m+         inTable = true;[39m
[31m+         html += '<table>';[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (line.includes('---')) continue;[39m
[31m+       const cells = line.split('|').map(c => c.trim()).filter((_, idx, arr) => idx > 0 && idx < arr.length - 1);[39m
[31m+       const isHeader = !html.includes('<tbody>');[39m
[31m+       if (isHeader && !html.includes('<thead>')) {[39m
[31m+         html += '<thead><tr>' + cells.map(c => '<th>' + formatInline(c) + '</th>').join('') + '</tr></thead><tbody>';[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         html += '<tr>' + cells.map(c => '<td>' + formatInline(c) + '</td>').join('') + '</tr>';[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       continue;[39m
[31m+     } else if (inTable) {[39m
[31m+       inTable = false;[39m
[31m+       html += '</tbody></table>';[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (line.startsWith('# ')) {[39m
[31m+       html += '<h2 class="md-h2">' + formatInline(line.slice(2)) + '</h2>';[39m
[31m+     } else if (line.startsWith('## ')) {[39m
[31m+       html += '<h3 class="md-h3">' + formatInline(line.slice(3)) + '</h3>';[39m
[31m+     } else if (line.startsWith('### ')) {[39m
[31m+       html += '<h4 class="md-h4">' + formatInline(line.slice(4)) + '</h4>';[39m
[31m+     } else if (line.startsWith('- ') || line.startsWith('* ')) {[39m
[31m+       html += '<div class="md-li">' + formatInline(line.slice(2)) + '</div>';[39m
[31m+     } else if (line.length > 0) {[39m
[31m+       html += '<p class="md-p">' + formatInline(line) + '</p>';[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (inTable) html += '</tbody></table>';[39m
[31m+   return html;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatInline(str) {[39m
[31m+   return escapeHtml(str)[39m
[31m+     .replace(/**(.*?)**/g, '<strong class="md-bold">$1</strong>')[39m
[31m+     .replace(/*(.*?)*/g, '<em>$1</em>')[39m
[31m+     .replace(new RegExp('`([^`]+)`', 'g'), '<code class="md-code">$1</code>')[39m
[31m+     .replace(/FAIL/g, '<span class="md-fail">FAIL</span>')[39m
[31m+     .replace(/WARNING/g, '<span class="md-warn">WARNING</span>')[39m
[31m+     .replace(/PASS/g, '<span class="md-pass">PASS</span>');[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ async function loadReport() {[39m
[31m+   const el = document.getElementById('dossier-report');[39m
[31m+   const fullEl = document.getElementById('dossier-report-full');[39m
[31m+   try {[39m
[31m+     const res = await fetch('/api/industrial/report');[39m
[31m+     const data = await res.json();[39m
[31m+     if (data.exists && data.content) {[39m
[31m+       const parsed = parseMarkdown(data.content);[39m
[31m+       if (el) el.innerHTML = parsed;[39m
[31m+       if (fullEl) fullEl.innerHTML = parsed;[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       if (el) el.textContent = 'Report not yet generated. Start the T-07 audit and review its approval first.';[39m
[31m+       if (fullEl) fullEl.textContent = 'Report not yet generated. Start the T-07 audit and review its approval first.';[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   } catch {[39m
[31m+     if (el) el.textContent = 'Unable to load report.';[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function escapeHtml(s) {[39m
[31m+   return String(s ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ </script>[39m
